hypotheses.N0_covariance_gap_survives: In every seed, the mixed model's generalized-rule Layer-0 rank is at least twice the pure model's on the same prompts under the full activation-covariance metric.
hypotheses.N1_fisher_gap_survives: The same twofold gap survives after additionally weighting answer-logit directions by the local softmax Fisher metric.
hypotheses.N2_margin_gap_survives: The same twofold gap survives when each operator is restricted to its correct-versus-strongest-rival margin direction.
hypotheses.N3_mixed_heldout_matches_mixed_train: Under Fisher-covariance weighting, generalized held-out rules remain within 20 percent of matched unselected training facts in every seed.
hypotheses.N4_high_confidence_gap_survives: On the 120 highest-margin generalized held-out rules, mixed-model Fisher-covariance rank is at least twice pure-model rank in every seed.
hypotheses.N5_depth_compression_survives_natural_me: Under Fisher-covariance weighting, the mixed held-out Layer-0 rank is at least three times final-layer rank in every seed.
